title: Connection to OL lost, unable to scan to reconnect.
symptom: Connection to OrangeLink (OL) lost, unable to scan for OL to reconnect. Pod Management Screen displays 'Rileylink address invalid'. Issue occurred on Android 12 devices and was reproducible by removing the RileyLink; no device shows up in scan.
cause: The issue was assumed to be related to new Android 12 Bluetooth permissions, and was fixed by a commit in AndroidAPS.
fix: The fix was implemented in commit e2bdc348349e6894c05eb0ba9809e378e10cb9d1. A user confirmed that after the fix, scanning works as intended.
